# Ziad M. Sheashaa: Software & AI Engineer

> Portfolio and profile of Ziad M. Sheashaa, a Software & AI Systems Engineer architecting machine learning models, computer vision pipelines, robotics, and full-stack software development.

## Core Expertise & Tech Stack

- **Artificial Intelligence & ML**: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, LangChain, LangGraph, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLM Fine-tuning, Vector Databases.
- **Computer Vision & Robotics**: OpenCV, Haar Cascades, SAM2, ROS (Robot Operating System), PID Controllers, Autonomous Navigation.
- **Software Engineering**: TypeScript, React, Next.js, FastAPI, C++20, Qt6/PySide6, Docker, Git.

## Featured Engineering Projects

- [Basira](https://github.com/aboellil0/Basira): AI-powered screening and psychological assessment platform for schools, providing early detection of behavioral and emotional indicators with secure analytics. Live platform: https://bassira.org
- [Nexcut Studio](https://github.com/Mohanadmomen/Nxtcut): Agentic desktop video editor with an on-device AI service, timeline architecture, and an agent layer featuring MCP-compliant tools, validated tool calls with retry loops, Whisper, SAM2, and Kokoro.
- [NASA 2025 - TERRA](https://github.com/ZiadMD/Nasa-2025): Educational web platform using Scikit-learn ML models to predict climate patterns from NASA data, featuring a Gemini API chatbot and interactive simulation game. Live demo: https://spatuim.vercel.app/
- [EVER 5th Generation](https://github.com/ZiadMD/EVER_CLoseLoop): AI-powered autonomous truck system combining machine learning, PID controllers, and computer vision for intelligent lane changes.
- [Cat-Dog Classifier](https://github.com/ZiadMD/cat-dog-classifier): PySide6 desktop application using TensorFlow for real-time image classification with custom deep learning models.
- [Qt-Cascade-app](https://github.com/ZiadMD/Qt-Cascade-app): Real-time desktop object detection application built with C++, Qt, and OpenCV using Haar cascade classifiers.
- [Safespace](https://github.com/ZiadMD/Safespace_node): Edge road-safety system. A Raspberry Pi node with a Sony IMX500 AI camera runs accident-detection models and streams RTSP; a containerized YOLOv8 central service handles accident inference and license-plate extraction.
- [ScreenSeekeR](https://github.com/ZiadMD/ScreenSeekeR-Desktop-Automation): Vision-based Windows desktop automation that locates UI elements from natural-language descriptions using cascaded visual grounding and vision LLMs.
- [Computer Vision x Arduino](https://github.com/ZiadMD/Computer-Vision-x-Arduino): MediaPipe face and hand tracking that sends labels over serial to an Arduino driving LED patterns.
- [Thaj](https://github.com/ZiadMD): Platform for student activities and organizations with flexible roles, attendance tracking, and AI follow-up agents.
- [Fitness, Nutrition & PT](https://github.com/ZiadMD/Nutrition-Graduation-Project): Graduation project platform combining fitness, nutrition, and physical therapy services with team care management.
